_meta.notes: Two bidirectional ESD diodes for a CAN bus pair: pin 1 K1, pin 2 K2 to CANH/CANL, pin 3 CC (common) to GND. VRWM 24 V, VBR 25.5-35.5 V, Cd 6 pF max, IEC 61000-4-2 contact 23 kV. QBZ = reel ordering code of type PESD2CANFD24V-QB. The pin-3 land is a T (two copper pads, both numbered 3).
